citeAs: Mohamed A. Rashad (2024). Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction. arXiv:2411.17835.
creator: Mohamed A. Rashad (Ain Shams University)
description: arabic-books is a large-scale dataset of 1.1 billion Arabic tokens extracted from over 8,500 books using the Arabic-Nougat SOTA OCR model. It provides a valuable resource for downstream NLP tasks and further Arabic OCR research.
name: arabic-books
rai:dataBiases: The dataset is derived from Arabic books and may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents. The source material is limited to book content, which may introduce genre and style biases.
rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by extracting Arabic text from over 8,500 books using the arabic-large-nougat OCR model, resulting in 1.1 billion Arabic tokens.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw data consists of Arabic book pages (scanned or image-based documents) from over 8,500 books, processed through the arabic-large-nougat OCR model to extract text.
rai:dataLimitations: The dataset was extracted using an OCR model (arabic-large-nougat) which may introduce errors, including hallucination and repetition artifacts. The content is limited to Arabic books and may not cover scientific, religious, or historical document styles. Complex layouts such as dense tables, charts, or images may not be well-represented.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset supports the digitization and accessibility of Arabic literature, promoting research in underrepresented languages and contributing to Arabic NLP and OCR advancements.
rai:dataUseCases: Downstream NLP tasks, Arabic OCR research, training data for Arabic language models.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: arabic-large-nougat (Arabic-Nougat OCR model) was used to extract text from Arabic book pages to produce the dataset.
